title: Battery thermal interfaces with microencapsulated phase change materials for enhanced heat exchange properties
abstract: Thermal interfaces containing microencapsulated phase change materials (PCMs) to improve heat exchange and regulate the temperature of battery cells.

title: Thermal management of battery systems
abstract: A method of operating a power supply system including discharging at least one cell element of a battery module to produce a quantity of power and a quantity of heat. Absorbing at least a portion of the heat in a phase change material (PCM) in thermal contact with the discharging cell element.

title: Vehicle heat pump system and method utilizing thermal storage
abstract: Heat pump systems and thermal storage media, which can include phase change materials, for use in vehicles with rechargeable energy storage systems.
